questions.answer: It is hard to find housing in Leiden and it was only because a friend told me to sign up half a year in advance.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: It is very expensive. Local laws and rules makes it difficult to be a tenant in the Netherlands. Floors are not always included in an apartment.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: The information was mostly in Dutch. Water and electricity were not included and were diffucult to get as a foreigner.
